items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Willie Wilson was leading the band. In other words, that was his band, and Johnny Wilson. Johnny Wilson played the baritone. And I went into the band

ctx.x: I didn't know you were, you played in the Eureka.

Yes. As Red, Red was playing trombone at that time. Willie Wilson was leading the band. In other words, that was his band, and Johnny Wilson. Johnny Wilson played the baritone. And I went into the band, and after he, and Shots, excuse me.
I remember Shots was in the Eureka band too.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I started playing in the band with Wilson, Lita, Schatz was the second man, but after I got into the band, and Wilson taking sick, well I started leading the band.

ctx.x: So this is real, too. Get out. What about in the 20s? Did you work with any brass bands

back then? Yeah, well I worked with practically all the brass bands in the 20s. Before depression? Yeah. Before 1929? I worked then, and during the depression I made practically all my living off of funerals. Who did you work with? What were the names of some of the brass bands in the 20s? Well, the original Eureka brass band. I started playing in the band with Wilson, Lita, Schatz was the second man, but after I got into the band, and Wilson taking sick, well I started leading the band. Wilson and Johnny, his…
